meta.title: Submit Appeal
meta.description: Submit an appeal for a moderation action on your account or content.

AppealPage.title: Submit Appeal
AppealPage.description: Provide your reason and evidence for review.

auth.loginDescription: You need to be logged in to submit an appeal. Please sign in to continue.

error.missingDescription: This page requires appeal context (appeal type and resource). Please use the link from your notification or email.
error.invalidGeneric: Something went wrong while loading the appeal. Please try again.

form.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why you believe this moderation decision should be reviewed. Provide as much detail as possible (minimum 20 characters).
form.reasonMinError: Reason must be at least 20 characters.
form.evidenceHint: Upload images that support your appeal (optional, max 5 files).
form.submitError: Failed to submit your appeal. Please try again.

evidence.dragAndDrop: Drag & drop images here, or click to browse
evidence.fileInfo: Max {maxFiles} files, {maxSizeMb}MB each • JPG, PNG, WebP
evidence.invalidType: Only image files (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF) are accepted.
evidence.tooLarge: File exceeds the maximum size of {maxSizeMb}MB.

success.title: Appeal Submitted!
success.description: Your appeal has been submitted successfully. Our moderation team will review it and notify you of the outcome.
success.notice: You'll receive an email notification once a decision has been made.

existing.title: Appeal In Progress
existing.description: You already have a pending appeal for this issue. Edit it or check its current status below.

pending.title: Appeal Already Submitted
pending.description: You already have a pending appeal for this issue. Please wait for it to be reviewed before submitting a new one.

BannedPage.title: Account Locked
BannedPage.description: This account has been suspended due to policy violations.
BannedPage.lockWithDays: Your account is locked for {days} more day(s).
BannedPage.nextStepOne: Our team will review your information. Check this page for updates.
BannedPage.nextStepTwo: If your account follows our standards, access will be restored.
BannedPage.nextStepThree: If the decision is upheld, the restriction may remain in place.
BannedPage.appealCardBody: Submit a concise appeal with supporting evidence so we can review your case faster.
